name: Cyntefin
text: Cyntefin, also written Cyntefyn, is an alternative Welsh name for Calan Mai, the May Day feast. The word carries the sense of the first of summer. The festival and its customs sit in the Calan Mai entry, which also touches the older fire feast of Beltaine.

attributes.attribute: an alternative Welsh name for Calan Mai

okr.objective: Cyntefin routes readers from the Welsh May Day name to the Calan Mai feast.
key_results: Cyntefin is an alternative Welsh name for May Day.
The sense of the word is the first of summer.
